variants.docling_flat: SectionHeaderItems snapshotted just before the heading-hierarchy stage: Docling's own levels (all 1).
variants.docling_hier: Same run after Docling's built-in HeadingHierarchyModel (docling.models.stages.heading_hierarchy).
variants.docling_addon: Same run, then the community add-on docling-hierarchical-pdf 0.2.0 ResultPostprocessor (bookmarks via PyMuPDF, else numbering/style); post-hoc, its time excluded.
variants.docling_hier_with_title: Side check: docling_hier plus `title`-labelled items (not part of the main comparison).
